name: Puncturing (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 10th; Price +2 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ability may only be placed on a piercing weapon. These weapons were designed to leave brutal wounds on unsuspecting targets. Whenever a puncturing weapon would deal sneak attack or other precision damage, that damage is increased by 1d6. Additionally any bleed damage dealt with a puncturing weapon has the heal skill check DC to remove it increased by 5.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, sneak attack
